To add a paid stamp in QuickBooks, follow these steps:

1. Look for your invoice template that you are using and right-click on it. Select "Edit Template" to open the Basic Customization screen.
2. Scroll down to the bottom section of the page called Company & Transaction Information and look for the box labeled "Print Status Stamp". Click on it to activate the status stamp.
3. If you want to remove the paid stamp from an invoice that has already been paid, first modify the template by creating a copy and renaming it "Void Invoice". Then un-check the "Print Status Stamp" box and save the changes.
4. For QuickBooks 2011 or earlier versions, the Paid stamp may not reflect the date the customer invoice was paid. In this case, you may want to manually record the payment date in another field or use a third-party application to track payments.
